dictionary_word.definition: edit · refresh · view Word of the day for November 22 plinky-plonky adj (chiefly music, informal) Especially of a musical instrument such as a piano: making sharp, tinny sounds; plinky.

articles.title: [Editorial] Multiple sclerosis: beyond controlling relapses
articles.author: The Lancet
articles.summary: Few neurological diseases have seen a transformation in diagnosis and treatment as remarkable as multiple sclerosis. A chronic, heterogeneous autoimmune condition, it typically begins in early adulthood and affects over 3 million people, with women roughly three times more likely to be affected than men.

articles.title: [Comment] Remibrutinib: a high-efficacy disease-modifying drug for relapsing multiple sclerosis?
articles.author: Gilles Edan, Emmanuelle Le Page
articles.summary: Bruton's tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitors directly modulate the functions of B lymphocytes and myeloid cells (notably macrophages and microglia) and thus target both the adaptive and innate mechanisms that contribute to the immunopathology of multiple sclerosis on either side of the blood–brain barrier.

articles.title: STAT+: Is MAHA’s think tank in the tank? Tax filings show low reserves
articles.author: Isabella Cueto
articles.summary: Tax filings show the MAHA Institute spent more than $1 million in 2025, ending its first year with just $171,000 as events and overhead drained its cash.

articles.summary: Microplastics may be doing something far more dangerous than simply accumulating in our bodies. Scientists have discovered that tiny plastic particles can interact with water to generate highly reactive molecules capable of damaging cells and tissues.

articles.title: FDA Approves First Drug to Treat Neurological Symptoms of Type 3 Gaucher Disease
articles.author: FDA
articles.summary: FDA today approved Infilbray (venglustat) tablets, the first treatment for the neurological symptoms of Type 3 Gaucher disease (GD3) in adults and pediatric patients weighing at least 15 kg (approximately 33 pounds).

articles.title: FDA Launches the Global Reliance Disclosure Program to Expand Patient Access to Medicines Worldwide
articles.author: FDA
articles.summary: FDA today announced the Global Reliance Disclosure Program (GRDP), a landmark initiative that will fundamentally transform how the FDA's regulatory drug and biologic approval decisions are leveraged by health authorities around the world.

articles.summary: Merck & Co.’s sacituzumab tirumotecan has improved overall survival in a phase 3 cancer trial, delivering a second pivotal global victory for the TROP2-directed antibody-drug conjugate.

articles.title: Nationwide study reveals real-world outcomes of pancreatic cancer surgery in China
articles.summary: Pancreatic cancer remains a highly lethal malignancy, with 118,700 new cases and 106,300 deaths recorded in China in 2022. To evaluate real-world clinical practices, a new report was published in Volume 9, Issue 3 of the Journal of Pancreatology in September 2026.

articles.title: Zombie cells may explain slower muscle recovery in older adults
articles.summary: A class of fatty acid molecules called prostaglandins may be responsible for why older adults often fail to recover muscle strength after illness or injury, while young adults quickly bounce back, a new study has found.

articles.title: Researchers uncover the mechanisms of adhesion formation after thoracic surgery
articles.summary: Intrathoracic adhesions can develop after thoracic surgery and increase the risk of complications during repeat surgery. However, the detailed molecular mechanisms underlying their formation have remained unclear.
